basic_info.description: This is truly a well maintained four unit building in the heart of Inner Sunset, centrally situated and walking distance to Golden Gate Park, UCSF, shops, & restaurant. Convenience location access to MUNI's-N Judah light rail & multiple bus lines. Building is easily maintainable , great opportunity for investor. The property features (2) three bedrooms/2 baths, & (2) two bedrooms/1 bath, all tenants occupied, with spacious garage good for 4-5 cars/automatic garage door opener!
